1. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel via fasteners forming an inner panel-extension joint, and attached to the door outer panel via a hemmed joint forming an outer panel-extension joint, to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel.

2. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the outer panel-extension joint is a hemmed joint [[and the inner panel-extension joint includes fasteners securing the panel extension to the common door inner panel]].

3. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the inner panel-extension joint includes __riveted__ fasteners securing the panel extension to the common door inner panel.

4. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 including at least one hinge that is mounted to the common door inner panel __via a frame member__.

5. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension configured to mate with the door outer panel, extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel and attached to the door outer panel to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel, __wherein the door assembly is configured to accommodate selective replacement of the door outer panel and the panel extension as a unit with an alternative door outer panel and an alternative panel extension__.

6. (Original) A method of assembling a vehicle door, the method comprising the steps of: (a) forming a panel extension separate from a common door inner panel and a door outer panel; (b) attaching the panel extension to the door outer panel; (c) mounting door hardware to the common door inner panel; and (d) attaching the panel extension to a periphery of the common door inner panel.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein step (b) is further defined by hemming the panel extension to the door outer panel __to form a hemmed outer panel-extension joint__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein step (d) is further defined by attaching __riveted__ fasteners to the panel extension and the common door inner panel.

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Cancelled)
